name: Fulton County Youth Commission
what_you_do: Serve as a Youth Commissioner. You share what teens think with the Fulton County Board of Commissioners. You give it advice. You also join planning meetings and community service projects.
who_can_apply: Fulton County residents in 9th to 11th grade. You must go to a school inside Fulton County lines.
pay_detail: Volunteer. The page does not mention a stipend.
duration: School year. Up to 20 hours a month for planning meetings and projects (over 120 hours a year).
deadline_text: The page says applications are usually open in May near the end of the school year. A past call (2024-25 term) closed May 24, 2024. No 2027 dates posted.
how_to_apply: Apply online with a two-page essay. Also get a one-page nomination statement. It comes from a teacher, counselor, principal or community member who has known you for at least a year.
notes: Contact on the page: 404-612-7386 or the county line 404-612-4000. The length of a term is not stated.
